title: Manufacturing Engineering Director
text:
The Figeac Aero Group has multiple locations across the world. Figeac Aero North America, located in Wichita, Kansas in the heart of the country, is a leading aerospace partner for detailed parts and sub-assemblies with specialization in saturation shot peening, shot peen forming, chemical processing, painting, assembly, non-destructive testing, and machining.

At Figeac Aero North America, we place a high value on our employees. Employees are given the opportunity to be a part of something special while achieving their career goals. We offer competitive compensation as a smaller company in addition to an attractive benefits package for qualified employees.

***Manufacturing Engineering Director***

***Salary****: $90,000 - $120,000*

**Experience:** 8+ years in Manufacturing Engineering discipline in Aerospace environment.

**Job Duties:**

* Responsible for coordinating and executing activities around the following: Leading technical teams in the improvement of current processes, transitioning new statements of work, being the focal point of communication between quality, operations, NC Programming and Planning.
* Monitor and enforce adherence to internal processes and standards to ensure a consistent product to the manufacturing floor.
* Collaborate with NC Programming, operations and Manufacturing Engineering on tool and fixture design.
* Review first part runs with Quality, Operations and NC Programming to verify a conforming part and acceptable manufacturing process.
* Mentoring and training of new Manufacturing Engineers/Planners.
* Interface with customer base to resolve engineering issues.
* Investigate and resolve manufacturing issues related to low profitability or excessive scrap.
* Engagement at the estimating stage on strategic packages to review engineering design and productivity concerns.
* Shop support and guidance on first article builds to ensure engineering compliance and manufacturing process design effectiveness.
* Provides planning, direction, and coordination for all technical activities while monitors performance to estimates, budgets and organization goals.
* Participates in developing organization and department goals and objectives.
* Manage and execute assigned projects to meet all project criteria on time and on budget.
* Transition Technical Phase of new work statements on time and achieve manufacturing targets.
* Be instrumental in reducing overall manufacturing costs of strategic work statements by reducing cycle times, setup, scrap, secondary operations content, raw material content and other process driven cost components.
* Enhance core competencies in complex machining and programming.
* Challenges others to develop as leaders while serving as a role model and mentor.
* Inspire coworkers to attain goals and pursue excellence.
* Recommend and implement process changes in order to improve cost, delivery, quality.
* Identifies opportunities for improvement and makes constructive suggestions for change.
* Analyze information and evaluate results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
* Leadership and Communications.
* Report progress and projects weekly to Leadership Team.
* Mitigate team conflict and communication problems.

**Education/Experience**

* A four-year Engineering degree and 8 years relative experience in an Aerospace Engineering discipline is required
* A minimum of 10 years’ experience in a Manufacturing Engineering discipline is preferred
* Extensive knowledge and experience in machining, inspection, tooling design, assembly, and lean manufacturing methodologies
* Familiarity with MRP systems and fundamentals
* Full knowledge and adherence to ITAR/EAR restrictions and responsibilities

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Ability to act with integrity, professionalism and confidentiality
* Mandatory background in an aerospace or manufacturing environment required.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including interpersonal, negotiation & conflict resolution.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
* Expert in all Microsoft Office 365 applications and knowledge of ERP programs preferred
* Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
* Self-motivated, innovative, practical, and adaptable
* Ability to speak, read, write, and understand English language
* Must be 18 years or older
* Must be a US citizen or legally authorized to work in the United States, not eligible for VISA sponsorship

**Working Conditions:**

* This position is 100% onsite (Wichita KS)
* Monday to Friday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm
* Some hours outside of office schedule may be required.
* Regular attendance is mandatory and must follow all work safety programs
* The essential duties job may require the ability to stoop; to reach; to stand, to walk and sit for extended periods of time; to push and/or pull objects weighing up to 30 pounds; to lift and carry objects weighing up to 15 pounds; to use finger dexterity to operate a computer and other office equipment and hand strength to grasp files and other objects; to perceive the attributes of objects by touch; to hear and verbally exchange ideas and information with the public, staff and others on the phone and in the office. Occasionally being on foot, bending, stooping, squatting, kneeling, climb stairs and kneeling and/or crouching to retrieve files and other items. Occasionally Lifting and carrying (with assistance) items weighing 20-50 lbs.

**Competitive Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance with competitive rates
* Company paid life & AD&D insurance
* Corporate YMCA memberships
* Paid Time Off
* Generous 401(k) with company match
* Life Insurance, AD&D, Disability & Voluntary options
* Employee Assistance Plan

Figeac Aero North America is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
